text:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp publish is blocked by a regen diff in the type outputs, CI flagged a semver break. anyone else see this?

rina: saw it earlier, looks like optional fields toggled required/optional between runs. very brief diffs, no actual API change.

casey: paste the diff?

alex: ```
--- a/packages/sample/src/types.ts
+++ b/packages/sample/src/types.ts
@@
-  phone?: string | null;
+  phone: string;
```

liam: that pattern usually comes from non-deterministic `examples` arrays in openapi.yaml or unordered object keys. a tiny doc comment can flip generator heuristics.

alex: we traced it to a recent auth/retry tweak that added an `x-note` to the OpenAPI for a mocked endpoint in the sample app. the note doesn't change contract, but it changed the YAML ordering.

regen-bot: triggered rerun of typegen job #4478

ci-bot: rerun started — job 4478

rina: short term fix: allow CI to auto-commit regen-only changes if they are reordering/description-only. that unblocks onboarding but feels risky.

casey: prefer canonicalization script: load openapi, stable-sort keys, normalize `examples` arrays by sorting by name or generating a deterministic hash, then write out canonical YAML. can be a small node script in dev-tools.

liam: agreed. also our semver-gate should not treat ordering-only diffs as breaking. gate should diff the API surface shape, not whitespace or descriptions.

alex: filed devex issue #2411 "canonize openapi before typegen to avoid regen nondeterminism" and linked the sample PR.

casey: for the release window, maintainers: if a PR only has a regen reorder (no param type/shape change), add the label `dx/regendiff-ok` and comment with the CI job. we'll retroactively tighten the gate after canonicalization lands.

liam: also noticed flaky test where mock response array order changed and caused auth/retry tests to fail intermittently. i'll pin mock server seeds and add an integration smoke to detect order-sensitive mocks.

rina: workflow proposal: (1) add canonicalizer script to dev-tools, (2) add canonicalizer step in CI pre-typegen, (3) relax publish gate to structural diffing, (4) revert any temporary auto-commit allowances.

alex: implemented temp workaround in PR #498 — relax the strict-check for one day to let onboarding queue drain. PR body documents semver risk and links devex#2411.

ci-bot: job 4478 succeeded on rerun

alex: thanks — onboarding unblocked. next sprint: casey and liam to pair on canonicalizer and gate changes.

casey: I'll prototype a canonicalizer by EOD and open a draft PR under dev-tools.

liam: will follow up on mock-seed changes and update the test suite.

regen-bot: noted follow-up tasks in devex#2411

alex: closing thread. leaving notes in contributor docs about regen diffs and how maintainers should handle them until the fix ships.
